trace.question: Please provide the full name of the away team that scored the most goals.
trace.evidence: full name refers to team_long_name; away team refers to away_team_api_id; scored the most goals refers to MAX(away_team_goal)

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1
trace.answer: The away team that scored the most goals is PSV.
